rules.output: transparent PNG only, never on a gradient or background
rules.never_mix_styles: Never send 3D Qbot references in a 2D request, or 2D references in a 3D request

locked_style: Flat 2D cartoon illustration, clean vector look, like a sticker or app mascot
Thick, even, solid black outlines around every shape, same weight everywhere
Flat cel shading: white surfaces with one soft cool-grey shadow tone, no gradients
Only one gradient allowed: the glossy highlight on the black visor
No 3D rendering, no realistic lighting, no texture, no grain, no drop shadow
locked_character: Small chibi astronaut robot, head about 45% of total height, short rounded limbs, rounded mitten hands
White helmet with a small white rectangular pad on top and white rounded ear pods
Large black glossy visor with one white curved highlight in the upper left; the face is shown only as coral-red LED eyes on the visor
White suit with thin coral-red seam lines on the chest, arms and legs
Thick coral-red bands at the wrists, upper arms, knees and ankles
Small rounded light-grey chest badge with a grey Qdrant Q logo
No mouth, no nose, no human face, no text

happy.label: Happy
happy.phrase: two thick smooth upward arcs, like closed smiling eyes

cheerful.label: Cheerful
cheerful.phrase: two bright smooth upward arcs, slightly tilted, relaxed and warm

excited.label: Excited
excited.phrase: two large smooth upward arcs with two small sparkle shapes beside them

playful.label: Playful
playful.phrase: two sideways V chevrons pointing inward, like squeezed laughing eyes

proud.label: Proud
proud.phrase: left eye a smooth upward arc, right eye a wink, confident

friendly.label: Friendly
friendly.phrase: two soft smooth upward arcs, gentle and welcoming

loving.label: Loving
loving.phrase: one large heart shape made of small square pixels, centred on the visor

curious.label: Curious
curious.phrase: two large round open eyes, attentive

focused.label: Focused
focused.phrase: two small calm eyes looking slightly down, concentrating

confused.label: Confused
confused.phrase: one frowning squiggle eye and one question mark, both made of small square pixels

neutral.label: Neutral
neutral.phrase: two simple round eyes, calm and steady

sad.label: Sad
sad.phrase: two half-closed droopy eyes, flat on top and curved underneath

angry.label: Angry
angry.phrase: two short thick lines slanting down toward the centre, like frowning brows

eye_style_note: References mix two eye styles: smooth solid shapes (happy, friendly, sad) and small square pixels (confused, loving). Phrases follow the reference for each emotion until Vanesa picks one style.

standing_front.label: Standing front
standing_front.phrase: standing upright facing the camera, arms relaxed at the sides

waving.label: Waving
waving.phrase: standing, one arm raised with an open hand waving, the other arm relaxed

pointing.label: Pointing
pointing.phrase: standing, body turned slightly, one arm fully extended pointing to the {direction}

presenting.label: Presenting
presenting.phrase: standing, one arm open with palm up, gesturing to the {direction} as if presenting something

thumbs_up.label: Thumbs up
thumbs_up.phrase: standing facing the camera, one hand raised giving a thumbs up

arms_crossed.label: Arms crossed
arms_crossed.phrase: standing confidently facing the camera with both arms crossed over the chest

thinking.label: Thinking
thinking.phrase: standing, one hand touching the side of the helmet, head tilted slightly

jumping.label: Jumping
jumping.phrase: jumping with both feet off the ground, both arms raised in celebration

sitting.label: Sitting
sitting.phrase: sitting on the ground, legs stretched forward, hands resting beside the body

sitting_laptop.label: Sitting with laptop
sitting_laptop.phrase: sitting cross-legged with an open plain grey laptop on the lap, hands on the keyboard, drawn in the same outlined cartoon style

side_look.label: Side look
side_look.phrase: body turned three-quarters away, head looking back over the shoulder at the camera

background_phrase: Fully transparent background, no floor, no ground shadow, no glow, no outline around the whole figure

references._note: PNGs here are Figma renders with the background removed. loving.png has the top of the helmet clipped by its Figma frame; scripts/export-references.mjs replaces all five with the uncropped 1024x1024 originals.

reference_selection: Master first, then the pose refs, then the emotion ref if not already included. Max 4 images, 2D only.

finish._note: No backdrop. Trim to the character, add even transparent padding, export at a fixed long edge.
